page.overview:
Who is Magma Commander?

The Magma Commander is a villain from the Agents theme. He is a cybernetic henchman of Dr. Inferno. He operates a hidden base close to the city from which he commands a horde of radio-controlled Magma Drones to attack it. The minifigure was first introduced in 2009, and has only been released in one set.
